2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that respondent No.1 as the plaintiff filed Title Suit No.3 of 1988 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Dacope, Khulna for seeking a .declaration that the certificate of auction dated 30.01.1975 held in Certificate Case No.220 AD.B.B of 196465 is collusive, fraudulent, without jurisdiction, illegal and not binding upon the plaintiffs on the allegation stating, inter alia, that the land comprising an area 3.64 acres under SA Khatian No.75 belonged to the plaintiff to the extent of 16 annas share. The plaintiff took loan from defendant No.2 by mortgaging the suit land. For recovery of loan money, Certificate Case No.220 ADBB of 1964-65 was filed before the Sadar Certificate Court, Khulna. The plaintiff paid taka 250 by two installments and due to his distress, he could not pay all the dues. On 12.07.1975, the plaintiff adjusted all the dues including the interest and as such the Bank is not entitled to have any amount. On 25.10.1975, the plaintiff came to know that under Certificate Case No.220 ADBB of 1964765, his mortgaged land was sold in auction on 30.01.1975 at a salami of taka 1,100.00 and the defendant took no possession of the suit land through Court in pursuant of such auction sale. At the time of auction sale, the value of the suit land was taka at about 27,000.00 that the plaintiff has suffered irreparable loss and injury due to such auction sale at a shockingly low price. The plaintiff has been in possession on producing various crops by cultivation. The defendant has not been in possession. No notice under sections 7, 46 of the Public Demands Recovery Act and no sale proclamation was ever served upon the plaintiff. The sale held is not sustainable in the eye of law since the entire certificate case proceeding is collusive and illegal. The plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Case No.12 of 1975-76 under section 23(2) of the Public Demands Recovery Act, but that was not, informed and as such, the plaintiff filed the instant suit. 

 14. The plaintiff (opposite party) has come with an allegation that 3.46 acres of land under SA Khatian No.75 was owned and possessed by the plaintiff (PW1) to the extent of 16 annas share and he took loan from Krishi Bank on mortgaging the suit land. It was further alleged that for recovery of such loan money, the Bank authority initiated certificate case bearing No.220 AD.BB of 1964-65 in the Sadar Certificate Court, Khulna in spite of re-payment of two installments. It has been also alleged that the plaintiff (opposite party) failed to repay the other installments due to his financial inability and however, he alleged to have cleared up all the dues including interest on 12.07.1975. It has been further alleged that the plaintiff (respondent) came to know from one Obinash Roy that the suit land has been auction sold and thereafter, he came to know on enquiry that under certificate case bearing No.202 AD.BB/1964-65, the land was auction sold at shockingly low price at a taka .1100.00 only whereas the value of such land was about of taka 27000.00. The plaintiff further has come with an allegation that no notice under section 7 and rule 46 of Public Demand Recovery (P.D.R.) Act and no sale proclamation was ever served upon him and as such, the alleged sale has been held illegally including the defendant by practicing fraud upon the Certificate Court and as such, the plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Case No.1275-76 under section 23 sub-section of P.D.R. Act and on the event of rejecting miscellaneous case, the plaintiff is compelled to file the present case.
